observations.claim: Daimler Truck independently states that it selected Aeva as long- and ultra-long-range LiDAR supplier for its series-production autonomous commercial-vehicle program, with Aeva start of production planned for 2026 and Daimler Truck production ramp planned for 2027; Daimler also states the selection followed multiple years of collaboration and qualification.

limitations: Customer-side confirmation materially strengthens source integrity but does not establish actual 2026 production commencement, realized volumes, revenue, unit economics, margins, or completion of the planned 2027 Daimler production ramp.
No score, underwriting conclusion, adjudication, or Alpha authority is asserted.

methodology: Methodology 1.0 preserved; append-only source acquisition; Beast/integrity gates and Earth Core canonical authority unchanged.
